name: Hitomi Yomi
source: Unlike her [url=/c14314]younger sister[/url], Yomi is a mature and staid girl. She's not afraid of difficulties and spends a lot of effort in order to succeed in swimming. Yomi is always polite and have respect for [url=/c14301]Genki[/url], who helped her to win the competition five years ago.
